about: Backup and restore (@core/backup): the records as a .json.gz file, one CSV or an Excel file (SheetJS, loaded only on that tap); a restore only adds what is missing, with a dry-run line first. Local here until a second kind of app wants it.
docs: backup: the Settings page is app/src/screens/backup-settings.js (its format, fields, columns and clean are the sample tasks': make them the app's own); the API is in app/public/backup/index.js. It needs the app's items(), put(record) and serverCopyIn() (cloud.js).
